title: Spectral-angular parametrization of open qudit dynamics: gap coordinates, Cartan structure, and GKLS decoupling
summary: Every $n$-level density matrix can be diagonalized as $ρ=U\,\mathrm{diag}(p_1,\ldots,p_n)U^\dagger$, splitting it into an eigenvalue vector $(p_1,\ldots,p_n)$ and a unitary eigenbasis $U$. We introduce a new coordinate system on the eigenvalue vector alone: the \emph{gap coordinates} $r_a:=p_a-p_{a+1}\ge0$, $a=1,\ldots,n-1$.
